description: This file defines the GrainPropertiesResolver class, responsible for resolving grain properties based on the cluster manifest in the Orleans framework. It includes methods to retrieve and try to retrieve grain properties for specific grain types, utilizing a cluster manifest provider.

classes.name: GrainPropertiesResolver
classes.description: A class that facilitates retrieving grain properties given a grain type, by interfacing with the cluster manifest provider.

methods.name: GetGrainProperties
methods.description: Retrieves the grain properties for a given grain type, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: TryGetGrainProperties
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve grain properties for a given grain type, returning a boolean indicating success and outputting the properties.
